_comment: Runner model catalogue (spike). EAGER: when the booster starts, every non-optional RUNNER below is dispatched at once (one GitHub-hosted 4 vCPU / 16 GB runner each, Ollama runtime). A runner may serve several models (fast = 3B chat + embeddings). ram_mb = weights + KV at the stated ctx (ESTIMATES, unmeasured on a runner). cache_ok=false: too big to share the 10 GB-per-repo actions/cache cap with another model, so it is pulled cold at every start/rotation. Ollama tags were NOT verified against registry.ollama.ai in the spike (no network calls to it); llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M / qwen2.5(-coder):7b-instruct-q4_K_M / qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M / nomic-embed-text are the documented library tags.

qwen2.5-3b.note: fast chat; same model as the in-Codespace AI pack

llama3.1-8b.note: tool use / agents; 4 big models cannot all share the 10 GB cache, LRU evicts

qwen2.5-14b.note: largest that fits 16 GB; slow (~2-3 tok/s on 4 vCPU)

aliases._comment: per-cloud API model id (or fnmatch pattern) -> catalogue id. Exact match first, then the longest matching pattern. Users add more with VYOMI_RUNNER_MODEL_ALIASES (JSON); Azure OpenAI DEPLOYMENT names map the same way (the SDK sends the deployment name).
